dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, look! Is it a shark?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, ˈlʊk! ɪz ɪt ə ˈʃɑːrk?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No, it isn't. It's a dolphin.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪt ˈɪzənt. ɪts ə ˈdɑːlfɪn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh! Is a dolphin a fish?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ! ɪz ə ˈdɑːlfɪn ə ˈfɪʃ?
